benchmark_abstractions.cause_class_coarsening: JANUS-added planning abstraction over source lanes; not a source claim that these four classes exhaust reality.
benchmark_abstractions.cost_model: All available tests use unit cost so the solver minimizes witness count only; no empirical monetary/time/resource cost is asserted.
benchmark_abstractions.pairwise_discrimination_edges: JANUS interpretation of what a successful source gate is designed to distinguish at this coarse cause-class level; every edge remains conditional on valid prospective execution.
benchmark_abstractions.availability: H1-H4 are available as prospective test designs. H5 is unavailable in the current benchmark because the source dossier reports no direct UAP-tachyon link/source-linked event suitable for that bridge gate.

cause_classes.description: Ordinary causal explanation, information leakage, artifact, post-hoc selection, or other non-retrocausal null compatible with the dossier's negative-control framing.
Decision Augmentation Theory / future-informed information-selection or biased-sampling model without a demonstrated force-like carrier.
Generic advanced-time / advanced-potential physical-channel hypothesis without identifying a tachyon-specific carrier.
Stronger carrier hypothesis requiring an independent physical observable specific to a tachyon model.

tests.benchmark_semantics: A preregistered independent pre-event effect surviving leakage controls can separate the ordinary/leakage null from the three retro-information hypotheses at this coarse level. It does not distinguish the three retro-information hypotheses from one another and does not itself prove retrocausality.
Temporal-kernel preregistration is retained as a validity/control witness. The dossier does not supply a carrier-specific temporal kernel that would justify a hard pairwise cause-class edge here.
The dossier explicitly frames this gate as separating information-selection/decision structure from force-like physical-system models. It does not by itself identify which physical carrier exists.
Only an independently observed tachyon-specific physical signature can separate the tachyon-carrier claim from generic/non-carrier alternatives. An anomalous p-value alone is explicitly insufficient.

Cross-domain extension only. The current source reports no direct UAP-tachyon-retrocausality link and no completed byte-level NARA bulk null, so this gate cannot be used to promote the core retrocausal cause classes.

expected_result.interpretation: Within this deliberately coarse planning model, H1 separates ordinary/leakage nulls, H3 separates DAT/information-selection from physical-channel models, and H4 is required for tachyon-specific carrier identity. H2 remains a validity control; H5 remains an unavailable cross-domain UAP bridge.
